race.comment: OUR JUSTIFY (14) is knocking on the door of another win, placing in all four starts this time in. Off a let up here having just missed behind a subsequent Saturday city winner in Puglia last time out. Finds a lovely race and with even luck from the inside she'll go close. BRUTALINA (8) hasn't been far away this time in, okay late over 1200m behind a good one last time in town. Back a notch now and should take catching. MOUNT SABYINYO (6) resumes having shown good ability in four runs to date, winning two. He's been jumping out very well and can pick up where he left off. UNTAPPED (4) comes back in grade and can figure.
